errors.text: The proposed secondary phase is Ti/Fe-rich BCC rather than the compositionally segregated hexagonal C14 Laves phase central to the target mechanism.

The hypothesis omits the antiferromagnetic coupling between the Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices, the associated reduction in saturation magnetization, and the phase-specific multiple magnetic transitions.
The cited evidence does not establish that Ti additions to an Fe-Co-Ni-Ti fcc alloy produce a coherent BCC phase or the proposed high-temperature interfacial coupling.
